ld.name: NATURELO, Magnesium Glycinate Chelate Complex, 120 Vegetarian Capsules
ld.description: From Nature With Love® With a Plant-Based Whole Food Blend Formulated to Support Healthy Bones, Heart, & Stress Relief Dietary Supplement No GMOs No Soy No Gluten Vegan Friendly No Coloring, Preservatives or Flavoring Vitamin Angels GMP - Good Manufacturing Practice Consistent Quality Suitable for Vegans and Vegetarians Whole Food Complex: 200 mg Magnesium plus organic vegetables and seeds with naturally-occurring magnesium, including organic spinach, swiss chard, okra, quinoa, black bean, pumpkin seed, sunflower seed and flaxseed. Magnesium Glycinate Chelate: Chelated with Glycine for better absorption and bioavailability. Glycinate is easy on the stomach, non-laxative, and enhances the natural calming benefits of magnesium. Relax Nerves & Muscles: Magnesium supports healthy muscle and nerve function to help relieve tension and discomfort for healthy physical performance, recovery, and relaxation. Supports Calm & Sleep: Magnesium supports the parasympathetic nervous system and helps regulate melatonin and GABA for a healthy stress response, calm mood, and better sleep.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Adults take one (1) capsule a day with food and a full glass of water.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Rice flour (brown), hypromellose (vegetarian capsule), rice bran extract.
Does not contain GMOs, soy, gluten, milk, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, or preservatives.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Caution: Keep out of reach of children. As with any supplement, if you are pregnant, nursing or taking medication, consult your doctor before using this product. Store in a cool, dry place.
Do not use if safety seal under the lid is broken or missing.
